cs.t: Seconding the vertical monitor from a thrift shop, I did the same thing basically by getting a Fujitsu monitor that can easily rotate and I'm incredibly pleased. I use it with multiple Emacs frames because PaperWM (Gnome extension) makes it easy to scroll between windows (in this case Emacs frames).
